{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the revenue column has no commas in the sample
sample_revenue = df['revenue'].head().tolist()
print(f'Sample revenue values: {sample_revenue}')

# Check if any revenue value contains a comma
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f'Do any revenue values contain commas? {has_commas}')

# Since no commas are present, we can directly convert to float
# But check for QA rows (999999.99) first
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA rows found: {len(qa_rows)}')

# Filter out QA rows
df_clean = df[df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal, completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
count_loyal_completed = len(df_loyal_completed)

print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders (after QA removal): {count_loyal_completed}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
